en_title: Black Panther 3 Release Date Confirmed by Marvel | Comic Con 2026
cn_title: 漫威确认《黑豹3》定档2028年12月15日
subtitle: 特查拉之子正式登场

paragraphs.en: Marvel has made Black Panther 3 official, and confirmed it will launch on December 15, 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威正式官宣《黑豹3》，并确认影片将于2028年12月15日上映。

paragraphs.en: Details of Ryan Coogler's upcoming threequel were confirmed today at San Diego Comic Con during Marvel's announcement panel in Hall H, where IGN was in attendance.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威今日在圣迭戈国际动漫展H厅举行发布会，IGN也到场参加。会上，官方确认了瑞恩·库格勒这部系列第三部作品的相关细节。

paragraphs.en: Notably, British actor David Jonsson was announced as starring in the film as the son of T'Challa, previously seen as a child in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever. Jonsson previously appeared in Alien: Romulus and The Long Walk.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，英国演员David Jonsson已确认加盟本片，将饰演特查拉之子——这个角色曾在《黑豹2：瓦坎达万岁》中以孩童形象亮相。Jonsson此前出演过《异形：夺命舰》和《漫漫长路》。

paragraphs.en: Letitia Wright will return as Shuri, while Winston Duke will reprise his role as M'Baku. So both of them presumably survive Avengers: Secret Wars, then.
paragraphs.cn: 莱蒂希娅·赖特将回归饰演舒莉，温斯顿·杜克也会再次出演姆巴库。如此看来，两人大概都能从《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》中活下来。

paragraphs.en: For a movie that Marvel had previously not officially confirmed, we actually did know a fair bit about the project before today. Coogler had made no secret of the fact that Denzel Washington is involved after revealing he had written a part specifically for him (and this was back in 2024!). Following this revelation, Kevin Feige then admitted that Black Panther 3 was being planned .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管漫威此前一直没有正式确认这部电影，但在今天之前，我们其实已经掌握了不少相关信息。库格勒早就公开表示丹泽尔·华盛顿会参与影片，还透露自己专门为他写了一个角色——而这已经是2024年的事了！此事曝光后，凯文·费奇也承认《黑豹3》正在筹备之中。

paragraphs.en: "Denzel is family at this point," Coogler said previously. "I've been trying to work with him since day one. I think he's the greatest living actor. In terms of what he means to our culture? Forget about it, man."
paragraphs.cn: 库格勒此前表示：「丹泽尔现在已经像家人一样。我从第一天起就一直想和他合作。我认为他是当今最伟大的演员。至于他对我们文化的意义？那更是无须多言。」

paragraphs.en: A third entry in the hit MCU Black Panther series had always seemed assured after the first entry hit $1.35 billion and its follow-up Wakanda Forever, which was retooled after the tragic death of original Black Panther star Chadwick Boseman, earned another $859 million.
paragraphs.cn: 《黑豹》系列首部电影斩获13.5亿美元(约合人民币92亿元)票房；在初代黑豹主演查德维克·博斯曼不幸去世后重新调整制作的续集《黑豹2：瓦坎达万岁》，又取得8.59亿美元(约合人民币58亿元)票房。因此，这个热门MCU系列推出第三部一直是意料之中的事。

summary: 漫威确认《黑豹3》将于2028年12月15日上映，瑞恩·库格勒回归执导。David Jonsson将饰演特查拉之子，莱蒂希娅·赖特和温斯顿·杜克也将回归。
opus_summary: 《黑豹3》正式定档2028年12月15日。瑞恩·库格勒继续执导，David Jonsson加盟饰演特查拉之子，舒莉与姆巴库也将回归。
